concept: Maintaining perspective on ordinary daily stress without minimizing genuine hardship
source_inspiration: original content, informed by Anne Frank's perspective-under-hardship legacy — not sourced from any external text

exercise.case_study: A realistic scenario where an adult is consumed by ordinary daily frustrations (commute, minor conflict, small setbacks)
exercise.reflection_prompt: What would it look like to hold this stress lightly, without pretending it doesn't matter at all?
exercise.practice: Adult identifies one recurring stress and one way to hold it with more perspective

assessment.success_marker: adult's approach neither dismisses the stress nor lets it dominate disproportionately
